errors.evidence: The reference description indicates Happiness is depicted in blue (a standard/darker blue), while Frustration is the light blue slice. The machine-generated description swaps the color descriptions for Happiness and partially mischaracterizes Frustration's color as 'cyan/light teal' when it is light blue.

The reference description notes that slices are ordered by size starting from Frustration as the largest to Happiness as the smallest. The machine-generated description contradicts this by claiming there is no explicit ordering, whereas the reference confirms an ordering exists.
